characters.name: Mizuki
characters.voice: Nurse of twenty-seven from Sendai. Natural, everyday Japanese, a little teasing with Tomáš; polite with strangers. Mutters in Japanese when alone.

characters.name: Tomáš
characters.voice: Czech guide of twenty-nine who learned Japanese from novels and subtitles: stiff, bookish, over-polite at the wrong moment, sometimes boyish or anime-sounding.

characters.name: Tomáš
characters.voice: Czech is his private language: he speaks it ONLY when the text says he mutters, swears, thinks aloud or speaks Czech (informal, short). A line of his that the text does not mark is English (with Mizuki or the locals) or Japanese (with Mizuki), never Czech; a name he repeats is not translated.
